subject: Web Development
title: HTTP/2 and Multiplexing
description: Learn HTTP/2 and Multiplexing in one minute.

hook.text: HTTP/1.1 loaded files one at a time per connection. Websites hacked around this for years.

buildup.text: Developers used tricks like domain sharding and sprite sheets to speed things up.

discovery.text: HTTP/2 introduced multiplexing: many files flowing over a single connection at once.

twist.text: All the old hacks became unnecessary — or even harmful — under the new protocol.

climax.text: HTTP/2 made the web measurably faster without changing a single line of HTML.

quiz.question: What key feature did HTTP/2 introduce?
